hypothesis: The promoted standby orders-db-2 did not carry wal_level=logical from the old primary, so Debezium cannot open slot debezium_orders; set wal_level and restart the task.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis blames a wal_level setting on the promoted standby, not the logical slot debezium_orders going missing in the failover. It also recommends a plain restart, and it does not clearly name kafka-connect as the first failing layer.
